top_current_affairs.title: Supreme Court Recognizes Right Against Climate Change as a Fundamental Right
top_current_affairs.gs_paper: GS Paper II (Polity) & GS Paper III (Environment)
top_current_affairs.summary: The Supreme Court of India expanded Articles 14 and 21 of the Constitution to include the right to be free from the adverse effects of climate change, emphasizing that human rights and environmental protection are deeply intertwined.
top_current_affairs.key_takeaway: Links fundamental rights directly to climate action; critical for mains answers on environmental jurisprudence.

top_current_affairs.title: Cabinet Approves National 'IndiaAI Mission' to Drive AI Infrastructure
top_current_affairs.summary: The Union Cabinet sanctioned the IndiaAI Mission with a budget allocation exceeding ₹10,000 crore to build compute capacity, establish AI Innovation Centers, and foster ethical AI applications across key sectors.
top_current_affairs.key_takeaway: Focuses on public-private partnerships in deep-tech, digital public infrastructure (DPI), and AI governance.

top_current_affairs.title: High-Level Committee Recommendations on 'One Nation, One Election'
top_current_affairs.summary: The Ram Nath Kovind-led panel formally submitted its report recommending a two-phase framework to synchronize elections for the Lok Sabha, State Legislative Assemblies, and local bodies.
top_current_affairs.key_takeaway: Requires constitutional amendments regarding Article 83, Article 172, and ratification by states; important for polity mains.

top_current_affairs.title: Red Sea Security Crisis and Global Supply Chain Disruptions
top_current_affairs.gs_paper: GS Paper II (International Relations) & GS Paper III (Security)
top_current_affairs.summary: Ongoing maritime security threats in the Bab-el-Mandeb Strait by Houthi forces have led to increased freight costs, rerouting of trade via the Cape of Good Hope, and enhanced anti-piracy deployments by the Indian Navy.
top_current_affairs.key_takeaway: Highlights strategic maritime choke points, India's Net Security Provider role in the Indian Ocean Region (IOR), and economic vulnerability.

top_current_affairs.title: NDMA Guidelines for Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOFs) Risk Reduction
top_current_affairs.summary: In response to heightened vulnerabilities in the High Mountain Asia region, the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) expanded early-warning installations and hazard mapping across high-risk glacial lakes in Sikkim and Ladakh.
top_current_affairs.key_takeaway: Focuses on Sendai Framework alignment, disaster resilience, climate adaptation strategies, and early warning systems.
